notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three: one line from the Forest Lookouts page and a hiking-app peak listing. The story is about 80 words because no further evidence was found after two searches; padding to 120 would invent content. PeakVisor's summit (44.861681 N, 121.95851 W) is roughly 0.3 km from the record point (44.86373, -121.96174). Not treated as a correction, because the lookout's own position is unknown and PeakVisor describes the peak. The 'supplementary' wording suggests a main station nearby, but no source names it. Not in the firelookout.org Oregon list, so no FFLOS status. No agency, build date, design, staffing or photos found.
